root.label: FHFA cuts inspector general budget and staffing

events.label: FHFA cuts inspector general budget and staffing

slots.name: requested budget share
slots.sentence: The inspector general had requested a budget equal to 16 percent of FHFA’s operating budget, according to the agency.

slots.name: average budget share
slots.sentence: FHFA said inspectors general across the federal government receive an average of about 2 percent of their agencies’ budgets.

slots.name: watchdog workforce share
slots.sentence: The watchdog’s employees also make up 18 percent of FHFA’s workforce, compared with an average of about 4 percent at other agencies, FHFA said.

slots.name: inspector general vacancy
slots.sentence: The agency’s inspector general position has been vacant since last year after Reuters reported the ouster of acting Inspector General Joe Allen.
